description_en: Calls the DescribeDBInstanceTopology operation to retrieve the topology information of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBInstanceTopology接口获取实例拓扑信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-db-instance-topology --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --start-time 2021-10-21T10:30:45Z_04:00:00 --end-time 2021-10-22T10:30:45Z_04:00:00 --minute-simple true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceTopology

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range for querying historical instances in the topology. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询拓扑中历史实例范围开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range for querying historical instances in the topology. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 查询拓扑中历史实例范围结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query the historical topology
parameters.name: minute_simple
